description: Na₂SrMg(PO₄)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.94 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.92 Å. Sr is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.56-2.95 Å. There are two inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.10 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.04 Å) and four longer (2.07 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-34°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.55 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-36°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.55 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Sr, one Mg, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Sr, one Mg, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Sr, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Sr, one Mg, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sr, one Mg, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Sr, one Mg, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Sr, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sr, one Mg, and one P atom.
